chunks.text:
[Verse]
Red, red, the ladybug is red!
Orange, orange, a fox from tail to head!
Yellow, yellow, the little chick says peep!
Green, green, the froggy loves to leap!
Blue, blue, the bluebird sings a song!
Purple, purple, grapes, come sing along!
positive_styles: clear simple lyrics, each word easy to hear

chunks.text:
[Chorus]
Red, orange, yellow, green,
blue and purple, can't you see?
All the colors, one, two, three,
make a rainbow just for me! Hooray!
